name: (04) Koldunic Sorcery (Way of Sorrow) — 2 Intermediate — The Weeping of Kruchina

system.description:
The koldun's glare can reduce someone to nothing but hysterical bawling, wailing, and gnashing of teeth. Some depressing notion overcomes the victim — vampires might mourn their lost humanity or lovers dead centuries past, while koldun believe the effect channels the collected sorrow of their demesne's sickened soil. As with all Way of Sorrow powers, a botch turns the effect back upon the koldun as if the victim had scored five successes.

System: The koldun's player spends a Willpower point and rolls Manipulation + Koldunism (difficulty equal to the target's Willpower). For one turn per success, the target is overwhelmed by intense misery and cries uncontrollably; any action requiring concentration is impossible for the power's duration. Vampiric victims lose a blood point each turn as vitae streams from their eyes.

MET System: Make your Way of Sorrow challenge (a Social Challenge against Willpower, Koldunism for retests) against a single opponent. If you win, the subject is overwhelmed with misery and breaks into hysterical sobbing; though he may still flee or defend himself, initiating any Mental or Social Challenge is impossible. You may extend the power with additional reflexive Social expenditures and retests, as with The Frustrations of Nestrecha. Each turn a vampiric opponent spends under this power costs him one Blood Trait to copious weeping of vitae.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
